{{Top|leg|canon=Repulsor-jet}}
{{Citation}}
A '''repulsorjet''', also known as a '''microrepulsor''', was a miniaturized [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engine used in a variety of small items, as well as in maneuvering thrusters by ships in atmosphere.

The [[Repulsor throwing razor/Legends|Rodian throwing razor]] was one such item, using a miniaturized engine to instill a "boomerang recall" feature into the weapon.

[[Remote/Legends|Remotes]] such as the [[Marksman-H combat remote]] utilized small repulsorjets to float, and small [[Cam droid/Legends|camera droids]] also utilized this technology.
